News & Trends

Nvidia is reportedly buying Hugging Face for $12.9B (4 minute read)

Nvidia has reportedly agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, though conflicting reports say a deal may not yet be signed. The acquisition would give Nvidia control of one of the largest open-source AI ecosystems and another route into cloud compute.
Amazon triples its Nvidia GPU order with 2 million more chips (4 minute read)

AWS plans to add another 2 million Nvidia GPUs, including Blackwell Ultra and Rubin systems, after demand exceeded its earlier million-GPU commitment. Nvidia's models and broader software stack will also expand across Bedrock and SageMaker.
🧠

Analysis & Opinions

The Coordination Tax in Your Software Estate (6 minute read)

Large companies with proprietary software should reconsider polyrepo defaults because repository boundaries create recurring coordination costs across ownership, backlogs, releases, and controls. A monorepo can make related software cheaper to change, improve reuse and enable broader AI productivity, but the business case should be based on measured coordination work and must account for migration, tooling, ownership, and access-control costs.
Nvidia's AI demand is starting to look supply-constrained (5 minute read)

Nvidia expects demand to continue outstripping supply as AI infrastructure spending expands across hyperscalers, enterprises, governments, and AI labs. Persistent constraints could increasingly shape enterprise pricing, procurement timelines, and architecture decisions.

Launches & Partnerships

Frontier models are coin-operated. AMD Instinct™ Coder puts your AI stack on free play. (Sponsor)

AI is the new SaaS sprawl, and every prompt is on someone else's meter. AMD Instinct™ Coder, powered by Spectro Cloud, routes inference to open models on local hardware for 70% savings vs frontier spend. Run the TCO math yourself.
Dun & Bradstreet Brings Commercial Graph to Perplexity (3 minute read)

Dun & Bradstreet is partnering with Perplexity to integrate its D&B Commercial Graph and risk analytics into Perplexity and the Perplexity Computer agent platform through Model Context Protocol servers. The integration gives business users access to verified company identities, ownership relationships, risk intelligence, and auditable data for workflows including KYC/KYB, procurement, finance, compliance, and sales.
Anthropic signs $45B AI compute deal with Nscale (2 minute read)

Anthropic will reportedly lease 460MW of AI capacity from Nscale's West Virginia campus in a six-year, $45 billion agreement. The deployment will use Nvidia Vera Rubin systems and is expected to come online in late 2027.
🎁

Miscellaneous

Claude Code on Console to Enterprise migration (8 minute read)

This guide explains how teams can migrate Claude Code access from the Console API to Claude Enterprise. Users generally do not need to move locally stored CLI session history. Administrators instead provision Enterprise accounts, configure identity and access controls, and have developers switch their login method, gaining centralized policies, analytics, audit logs, and hierarchical spend limits.
Nutanix built a $20M internal AI cluster to cut SaaS AI costs (3 minute read)

Nutanix built a $20 million internal AI cluster partly to reduce its reliance on services such as Copilot and Claude. The company expects the infrastructure to pay for itself within roughly a year.
